name: Gentle Lunar Lander

meta.name: Gentle Lunar Lander
meta.tagline: Steer the lander onto a shrinking pad without a hard touchdown.
meta.description: Guide a lunar lander sideways and control its descent with the main engine. Gravity increases and the landing pad narrows as you approach the surface, so watch your speed and line up for a gentle touchdown.

rewardTerms.description: Time spent flying before landing or failure, in seconds.
Time spent descending at a controlled speed while aligned with the pad.
Fraction of the starting altitude descended.
Bonus for touching down inside the pad at a gentle speed.
Crashes, leaving the flight area, or timing out.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Land safely while keeping the approach controlled.

presets.name: aggressive
presets.description: Prioritize reaching the pad and completing the landing.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Reward a long, controlled flight and strongly discourage mishaps.

human.hint: Use Up to fire the main engine and Left/Right to steer. You can combine Up with either direction.
